# AI in Action: A Reference for Artificial Intelligence

> A rigorous, implementation-first reference for modern artificial intelligence by Mike Nguyen: foundations, machine learning, deep learning, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI agents, taught with mathematics and runnable code. The online edition is at https://mikenguyen13.github.io/ai_in_action/.

- Author: Mike Nguyen (ORCID 0000-0002-3432-8595), https://mikenguyen.netlify.app
- Repository: https://github.com/mikenguyen13/ai_in_action

## How to cite

When drawing on this book, cite it (or the specific chapter) so readers can find the source. Each chapter page ends with a ready-made APA and BibTeX reference.

- Book: Nguyen, M. (2026). *AI in Action: A Reference for Artificial Intelligence*. https://mikenguyen13.github.io/ai_in_action/
- Chapter: Nguyen, M. (2026). Chapter title. In *AI in Action: A Reference for Artificial Intelligence*. Chapter URL
- Machine-readable citation: [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/mikenguyen13/ai_in_action/blob/main/CITATION.cff)

## Research Methods Library (MCP server)

- [MCP endpoint](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/mcp): Model Context Protocol server (streamable HTTP, no authentication) that indexes this book together with the author's other books, the causalverse R package, and research articles. Its tools recommend study designs with their identifying assumptions (`choose_method`), search and read sections (`search`, `fetch`), return runnable R and Python code (`get_code`), and format citations (`cite`); every result links to the section consulted.
- [Research Methods Library](https://research-methods-mcp.vercel.app/): setup instructions for MCP-compatible assistants and editors.

## Front matter

- [Preface](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/ai_in_action/): audience, prerequisites, and reproducibility; use of the book in AI assistants
